title: Find Emotionally Consistent Users
summary: SQL: reactions(user_id,content_id,reaction), unique by user/content. Keep users who reacted to at least five content items and have one reaction type accounting for at least 60 percent of their reactions. Return user_id,dominant_reaction,reaction_ratio, rounding the fraction to two decimals. Sort ratio descending then user_id ascending. The 60-percent rule prevents a tie for dominant type.
officialConstraints: IDs are integers and reaction is text; primary key (user_id,content_id).
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
